meta_description: Lightsticks, slogans, photocard binders — rent what you need for the concert and return it after.
hero_tag: K-pop Concert Item C2C Rental Marketplace
hero_p: Don't buy an expensive lightstick just to leave it in a drawer. Rent on dolpin, enjoy the concert, and return it.
feature_lightstick_desc: Don't buy an expensive lightstick for a single concert. Rent one from a nearby fan and return it after the show.
feature_escrow_desc: Escrow payments keep both sides safe. Deposits are guaranteed to be refunded upon return.
feature_bt_desc: Verify official lightsticks via Bluetooth before renting. No counterfeits, no surprises.
feature_global_desc: Korea, Japan, Indonesia, and everywhere K-pop lives. Rent locally wherever the concert is.
step_1_desc: Find lightsticks available near the concert venue.
step_2_desc: Book the item and pay securely through escrow.
step_3_desc: Meet the owner and pick up your lightstick.
step_4_desc: Return the item after the concert. Get your deposit back.
cta_desc: Download dolpin and find lightsticks available at your next concert.
